cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Delegate Downward
cards.instruction: Make someone accept an unwanted responsibility by placing them lower in the hierarchy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. As junior coordinator, you're responsible for the blocked sink. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I ran the whole event yesterday. You said I'd earned a promotion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. To senior coordinator. Still below me, but now you can supervise the plumber.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He can only come after everyone leaves.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll lock up too. I can't give building security to a junior.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 junior and A3 still below me justify sink duty; A5 adds lockup, but S02 cooperative dependence is weak because each concern only adds burden.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 promised promotion causes A3 senior title; B4 late plumber causes A5 lockup.

relationship.evidence: B2 has earned recognition and B4 practical timing; A uses both without a tangible helpful concession beyond title.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns the promoted rank into grounds for another unwanted job.

specificity.evidence: A1 blocked sink and B4 late plumber establish the responsibility.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 prefixed charge is redundant with explicit below-me hierarchy.
